name: iam:PutRolePolicy
description: A principal with iam:PutRolePolicy can attach inline policies to any role they have this permission on. This is frequently exploited for self-escalation by granting the caller's own role full administrative access.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role must be in Resource section; for self-escalation, must have permission on own role

additional.description: Discover existing inline policies on the role
Required when starting as a user to assume the target role

admin: Role must have iam:PutRolePolicy permission on itself
If starting as a user, must be able to assume the target role
lateral: Role must have iam:PutRolePolicy permission on itself
If starting as a user, must be able to assume the target role

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: ARN of the role to escalate (auto-detected from caller if caller is a role; required when caller is a user)

options.name: POLICY_NAME
options.description: Name for the inline policy to add

options.name: VERIFY
options.description: Verify escalation by calling iam:ListUsers after (true/false)

options.name: AUTO_SWITCH
options.description: Automatically switch to new identity after assuming role (true/false)
